entries.text: 1 -Mobile Stadium
2 -Play with Battle Data
3 -Play with a Friend's Data
4 -Rules Data
5 -Organize Data
<FONT,PUSH,20><COL1,PUSH,110,150,255,255>***<COL1,POP><FONT,POP>What is Mobile Stadium?<FONT,PUSH,20><COL1,PUSH,110,150,255,255>***<COL1,POP><FONT,POP>

<LINE,33>This is where you can play using data obtained
in POKéMON Crystal. You can battle using
Battle Data, watch battles, and study new
Battle Rules.
<FONT,PUSH,20><COL1,PUSH,110,150,255,255>***<COL1,POP><FONT,POP>How do I use it?<FONT,PUSH,20><COL1,PUSH,110,150,255,255>***<COL1,POP><FONT,POP>

<LINE,33>Use the Mobile
GB Adapter to
connect your Game
Boy to a mobile
phone. Download the
data to POKéMON
Crystal.
<FONT,PUSH,20><COL1,PUSH,110,150,255,255>***<COL1,POP><FONT,POP>What is Battle Data?<FONT,PUSH,20><COL1,PUSH,110,150,255,255>***<COL1,POP><FONT,POP>

<LINE,33>This is information on other trainers, such as
which POKéMON they used and how they did in
battle. You can get this data from the Crystal
version.
<FONT,PUSH,20><COL1,PUSH,110,150,255,255>***<COL1,POP><FONT,POP>What can you do with a Battle Data?<FONT,PUSH,20><COL1,PUSH,110,150,255,255>***<COL1,POP><FONT,POP>
<LINE,33>You can check to see how the\nother trainers are doing in\ntheir battles.
<FONT,PUSH,20><COL1,PUSH,110,150,255,255>***<COL1,POP><FONT,POP>How many Battle Data files are there?<FONT,PUSH,20><COL1,PUSH,110,150,255,255>***<COL1,POP><FONT,POP>
<LINE,33>You can have three Battle Data files on the\nCrystal Game Pak and six files on the\nN64 Game Pak.
<FONT,PUSH,20><COL1,PUSH,110,150,255,255>***<COL1,POP><FONT,POP>What is a Friend's Data?<FONT,PUSH,20><COL1,PUSH,110,150,255,255>***<COL1,POP><FONT,POP>

<LINE,33>POKéMON Crystal version, a Game Boy, a
Mobile GB Adapter, and a mobile phone are all
you need to enjoy Mobile Battles with friends.
Battle friends from far away without using a
Game Link Cable. Friend Data records the
POKéMON in your party during those battles.
<FONT,PUSH,20><COL1,PUSH,110,150,255,255>***<COL1,POP><FONT,POP>What can you do with your Friend's Data?<FONT,PUSH,20><COL1,PUSH,110,150,255,255>***<COL1,POP><FONT,POP>

<LINE,33>Battle against the trainer in the Friend Data.
Friend Data from Mobile Battles is saved to
your POKéMON Crystal Version Game Pak.
Transfer it to the Nintendo 64 to store up to
eight Friend Data records.

<LINE,33>You can get new Battle Rules from the Crystal
Game Pak. Just choose Rule Select on the
Options menu, then save up to eight rules
settings on your N64 Game Pak.

<LINE,33>Battle Data, Friend's Data and Rule Data can be
saved to or deleted from the N64 Game Pak.
This data cannot be saved back to the
Crystal Game Pak.

<LINE,33>Connect your Game Boy and mobile phone using
the Mobile GB Adapter.

<LINE,33>Connect to the Mobile Center and download data
to POKéMON Crystal version.

<LINE,34>Insert the updated Game Pak into the
Transfer Pak to play Mobile Stadium.
<FONT,PUSH,20><COL1,PUSH,110,150,255,255>***<COL1,POP><FONT,POP>What is Rule Data?<FONT,PUSH,20><COL1,PUSH,110,150,255,255>***<COL1,POP><FONT,POP>
<FONT,PUSH,20><COL1,PUSH,110,150,255,255>***<COL1,POP><FONT,POP>How do I organize data?<FONT,PUSH,20><COL1,PUSH,110,150,255,255>***<COL1,POP><FONT,POP>
Mobile GB Adapter
Mobile Center
<LINE,33>A PLAY icon will appear during the demo.\nPress START to quit at any time. You can also\nchallenge that trainer.

<LINE,33>Be sure both players are using the same color
Mobile GB Adapter. Otherwise, you won't be able
to trade or battle.
6 -Others
<FONT,PUSH,20><COL1,PUSH,110,150,255,255>***<COL1,POP><FONT,POP>Others<FONT,PUSH,20><COL1,PUSH,110,150,255,255>***<COL2,POP><FONT,POP>

<LINE,33>Once you have saved your Crystal data to the
N64, you can play without the Crystal Game Pak.
You can watch a match between the trainers
saved in your battle data files or play against a
Red, Blue or Yellow version.

<LINE,33>Even if your connection time expires and you
can no longer connect, your Friend Data will
already be saved. After disconnecting, you
can continue the battle against the computer
at your own pace.

You can't download
the same data twice.

<LINE,34>From then on, Mobile Stadium
can be selected in POKéMON
Crystal version.

<LINE,33>The downloaded data can then
be used in Mobile Stadium on
the Nintendo 64.

<LINE,33>The next time you turn the
power on, the screen shown on
the left will appear.

<LINE,34>If you start POKéMON Stadium 2 with a
POKéMON Crystal Game Pak that has displayed
this screen Mobile Stadium will appear on the
menu!
Please select GB Game Pak.
Download activated at Mobile Stadium\nPOKéMON Crystal version.
Please press A Button.
